mapper.sql: RTRIM(LANG_CD) AS LANG_CD, RTRIM(GROUP_CD) AS GROUP_CD, RTRIM(CODE) AS CODE, NAME, ORDER_NO
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM T_CODE
ORDER BY LANG_CD, GROUP_CD, ORDER_NO, CODE OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM T_CODE WHERE RTRIM(LANG_CD) = #{langCd} AND RTRIM(GROUP_CD) = #{groupCd} ORDER BY ORDER_NO, CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_CODE (LANG_CD, GROUP_CD, CODE, NAME, ORDER_NO) VALUES (#{langCd}, #{groupCd}, #{code}, #{name}, #{orderNo,jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_CODE WHERE RTRIM(LANG_CD) = #{langCd} AND RTRIM(GROUP_CD) = #{groupCd} AND RTRIM(CODE) = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT RTRIM(LANG_CD) AS LANG_CD, RTRIM(GROUP_CD) AS GROUP_CD, GROUP_NAME FROM T_CODE_GROUP ORDER BY LANG_CD, GROUP_CD
SELECT RTRIM(LANG_CD) AS langCd, RTRIM(GROUP_CD) AS groupCd, GROUP_NAME AS groupName FROM T_CODE_GROUP WHERE RTRIM(LANG_CD) = #{langCd} AND RTRIM(GROUP_CD) = #{groupCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_CODE_GROUP (LANG_CD, GROUP_CD, GROUP_NAME) VALUES (#{langCd}, #{groupCd}, #{groupName})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_CODE_GROUP WHERE RTRIM(LANG_CD) = #{langCd} AND RTRIM(GROUP_CD) = #{groupCd}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_CODE WHERE RTRIM(LANG_CD) = #{langCd} AND RTRIM(GROUP_CD) = #{groupCd}
